## 发生了什么
10月5日，$KTOS 公布了一批太空和网络安全奖项，标题写的是"more than $100 million"。公司是靠新闻稿宣布的。到10月16日，SEC 的 EDGAR 最近十条记录里没有一份 8-K。

## 关键数字
这十条记录从8月26日排到10月16日，全部是 Form 3、Form 4、Form 144，外加一份 POSASR 和一份 424B3。前三种多是内部人持股和交易的报表，后两种是和证券发行有关的文件，都不是讲合同的。

## 简单说
8-K 可以理解成上市公司出了大事要交给监管机构的公告，里面通常会写清合同编号、钱什么时候执行、进展到哪一步。没有它，投资人手上只剩标题上那个数字，没法对账。这不代表合同是假的，新闻稿可能是真的，只是申报里找不到能核对的部分。

## 为什么重要
判断一个订单值不值得算进预期，先看它查不查得到。查得到的才算进预期，查不到的只是一条新闻。等公司把金额、期间和里程碑写进申报，再把这个数字算进去也不迟。

## 投资角度
$KTOS 这笔"more than $100 million"的消息，目前只有新闻稿支撑。在申报里能查到之前，它更适合当作待验证的线索，而不是已经确定的收入。

en.title: $KTOS Announced Awards "More Than $100 Million," but No Matching Filing Shows Up
en.deck: A number only counts toward expectations once it can be matched to official filings. Otherwise, it is just news.
en.body:
## What Happened
On October 5, $KTOS announced a batch of space and cybersecurity awards. The headline said "more than $100 million." The company made the announcement through a press release. As of October 16, none of the latest ten records on the SEC's EDGAR system was an 8-K.

## Key Numbers
These ten records run from August 26 to October 16. All of them are Form 3, Form 4, or Form 144 filings, plus one POSASR and one 424B3. Most of the first three are reports on insider holdings and trades. The last two relate to securities offerings. None of them describe contracts.

## In short
An 8-K is a notice that a public company files with regulators when something important happens. It usually spells out the contract number, when the money takes effect, and how far the work has progressed. Without one, investors only have the number in the headline, and they cannot check it. This does not mean the contract is fake. The press release may be accurate. The filings just do not show anything that can be checked.

## Why It Matters
Before you count an order in your expectations, check whether you can find it in filings. Orders you can find can count toward expectations. Orders you cannot find are just news. Once the company puts the amount, the time period, and the milestones in its filings, it is still not too late to count the number.

## Investor Angle
For now, the "more than $100 million" news for $KTOS is backed only by the press release. Until it shows up in a filing, treat it as a lead to verify, not as confirmed revenue.

en.body:
## What happened
$AVAV signed three MOUs within one week. An MOU is a memorandum of understanding. It means the two sides first put their cooperation intent in writing. The Australia one was signed on October 8, but it was not made public until October 13.

## Key numbers
- Three MOUs, all signed within one week.
- Signed on October 8, made public on October 13.
- The press release has no amounts, and none of the three is binding.
- The stock fell about 5% on October 14.

## In short
An MOU is a bit like two companies agreeing that they may work together later. But it does not say how much work will be done or how the money will be paid, and no one has to follow through. It is more of a direction signal than business already in hand.

## Why it matters
Many people see "signed several cooperation deals" and think of revenue growth. But a deal with no amount is hard to turn into actual revenue. The stock fell about 5% on the day after the release, which suggests the market did not treat this news as good news.

## Investment angle
The news on $AVAV has no amounts and no binding force, so for now it is better treated as information that still needs to be verified. Next, watch whether these intentions become formal contracts, and whether those contracts include specific amounts. This is an analysis angle, not a buy or sell recommendation.

## 发生了什么
据 Bloomberg 2026年9月4日引述知情人士报道，DeepSeek 计划在内蒙古的数据中心部署至少 160,000 颗华为昇腾 950DT，目标是吉瓦级的 AI 基础设施。

## 关键数字
第一个数字是 160,000，是 DeepSeek 一家的订单，主要用来跑自家模型做推理，目前没有计划拿来训练。第二个数字是 low hundreds of thousands，这是知情人士给的量级说法，指高端内存等零部件短缺后，华为 950DT 今年整体产量被压到的水平。第三个数字是一年以上，填满这张订单可能要这么久。

## 简单说
推理可以理解成模型训练好之后，实际回答问题、干活的那部分算力。这一单会吃掉华为今年产能里很大的一块。订单一天就能签完，零部件产能却不会跟着一天变出来，所以卡点落在内存上，短期内解不开。

## 为什么重要
看 AI 芯片大单能不能按时交付，别只看订单有多大，要看最紧的那个零件。这里最紧的是内存，所以先盯住交付时间这个数字。

en.title: DeepSeek Orders 160,000 Huawei Ascend 950DT, but Delivery Could Take More Than a Year
en.deck: The order is not the problem. Capacity for high-end memory and similar parts is the bottleneck, so this large order can only be delivered slowly.
en.body:
## What happened
According to Bloomberg, citing people familiar with the matter, DeepSeek plans to deploy at least 160,000 Huawei Ascend 950DT chips at its data center in Inner Mongolia. Reported on September 4, 2026. The goal is gigawatt-scale AI infrastructure.

## Key numbers
The first number is 160,000. It is DeepSeek's order alone. Most of it will run the company's own models for inference. There are no plans to use it for training at this time.

The second number is low hundreds of thousands. This is a rough size given by the sources. It is the level that Huawei's 950DT output for this year has been pushed down to, after shortages of parts such as high-end memory.

The third number is more than one year. That is how long it could take to fill this order.

## In short
Inference is the computing that runs after a model is trained. It answers questions and does the work. This order will take up a large part of Huawei's capacity this year.

The order can be signed in a day. But parts capacity does not grow in a day. So the bottleneck is memory, and it cannot be fixed in the short term.

## Why it matters
When judging whether a big AI chip order will ship on time, do not look only at how large the order is. Look at the tightest part. Here, the tightest part is memory. So watch the delivery time figure first.

A single cluster currently processes 155 trillion tokens per day. Revenue is $38 per GPU per hour, calculated at off-peak pricing. DeepSeek itself published these figures.

## In short
A token is a small piece of text that a model reads and writes. A cluster handles this many pieces every day, and each GPU brings in $38 per hour. That is the math behind the business. The $38 figure uses off-peak prices, so it should not be applied directly to every time period.

## Why it matters
Many AI companies talk about how strong their models are. Few open their books. DeepSeek released its revenue figures along with its code. Outside observers now have a real benchmark to compare against.

en.body:
## What Happened
Mistral AI and NVIDIA announced a new partnership. The goal is to bring AI into industrial engineering. The two companies named three areas: faster simulation, open physical AI benchmarks and datasets, and methods for evaluating agentic AI in CAE and EDA.

## In short
Simulation means building something on a computer first. Engineers use it to check whether a part will break under load or whether air flows smoothly past it. EDA is the software used to design chips. CAE stands for computer-aided engineering. Agentic AI is AI that can split a task into steps by itself and use tools to finish it. Until now, engineers did this work by hand, one step at a time. Now the goal is for AI to run the work and make the calls.

## Why It Matters
Open benchmarks and datasets let people use the same yardstick to compare how well AI handles physics problems. They no longer have to rely only on what vendors say. Faster design usually means cheaper trial and error.

## Investment Angle
NVIDIA ($NVDA) is one of the parties to this partnership. Announcements like this show its AI ecosystem reaching into industrial software. But an announcement is not revenue. Whether the work actually gets deployed later is worth watching more closely.

## 发生了什么

AeroVironment 公司在 2026 年 9 月 9 日的幻灯片上列出了一批订单。其中 LOCUST 激光武器拿到了第一笔海外商业订单，金额是 $52 million。LOCUST 是一套激光武器系统，简单说就是用光束去打击目标。

这一单说明 LOCUST 开始有了海外商业客户，是从单一项目走向更大市场的第一步。对激光武器来说，有人愿意付钱买，比演示效果更能说明问题。

en.deck: A foreign buyer has placed an order for a laser weapon for the first time. This shows that this type of equipment is moving toward commercial sale, not just staying in development.
en.body:
## What happened

On a slide dated September 9, 2026, AeroVironment listed a batch of orders. One of them, the LOCUST laser weapon, won its first overseas commercial order. The order is worth $52 million. LOCUST is a laser weapon system. In short, it uses a beam of light to hit targets.

## Key numbers

- $52 million: LOCUST's overseas commercial order
- $43 million: Integrating the PANTHER phased array antenna into the SkyRange platform, for hypersonic telemetry
- $1,257 million: Total of the seven orders on the slide
- Of that total, $500 million is the contract ceiling for Titan, but only $80 million was actually ordered
- Removing the part that was not ordered, the confirmed orders come to about $837 million (this is our own calculation)

## What it is used for

A phased array antenna does not need to turn physically. It uses electronics to point the signal beam where it is needed. When the SkyRange platform carries one, it can do hypersonic telemetry. That means collecting data on targets flying at very high speed. The $43 million job is about building this antenna into the platform.

## Why it matters

This order shows that LOCUST has started to win overseas commercial customers. It is a first step from a single project toward a larger market. For laser weapons, a buyer willing to pay says more than a demo does.

## Investment angle

All of these orders belong to $AVAV. Do not look only at the total when you review orders. Within the $1,257 million, $500 million is only a ceiling, so the part that was actually ordered should be viewed separately. A ceiling is not the same as revenue. When you read financial reports, separate "ordered" from "might be ordered." This is a research lead, not a buy or sell recommendation.

Meta，股票代码 $META，它的五年期 CDS 创了历史新高。CDS 全称是信用违约互换，你可以把它理解成一份"违约保险"：买保险的人定期付钱，如果借钱的公司真的还不上，卖保险的人就要赔。

en.title: Meta's Five-Year Default Insurance Price Hits a Record High, Latest at 114.5 bps
en.deck: The price of this insurance has hit a record, which shows the market is more worried than ever about whether a big company can pay back its debt.
en.body:
## What happened

Meta, ticker $META, saw its five-year CDS hit a record high. CDS stands for credit default swap. You can think of it as default insurance. The buyer pays on a regular schedule. If the borrowing company really cannot pay, the seller of the insurance has to pay out.

## Key numbers

- The latest quote is 114.5 bps, the highest level on record. The data comes from Markit.
- bps is a small unit that is common in finance. A higher number means it costs more to buy this insurance.
- The higher the CDS, the more the market worries about default.

## What it is used for

Prices like this are often used to see how the market feels about a company's credit. They do not directly show whether the company is doing well. But they do show how nervous people are.

## Investor angle

The price of default insurance on $META has hit a new high. This means some people are willing to pay more to protect against Meta defaulting. This is only a market signal. It does not mean Meta will run into trouble, and it is not a buy or sell recommendation.

## In short

Meta's five-year CDS has risen to its highest level on record. The market is more worried than before about whether Meta will pay back its debt.

## Memory

$MU's quarter ended September 3 brought in $54.23B in revenue. A year earlier, the same quarter was $11.32B, close to 4.8 times smaller. GAAP gross margin was 86.8%. Net income was $37.70B, a net margin close to 70%. Next quarter's guidance is $61.5B, plus or minus $1.5B. Gross margin guidance is 85.95%.

## Foundry

$TSM's third-quarter revenue was $46.72B, up 41.2% year over year. Gross margin was 66.4%, down from 67.7% the quarter before. Revenue rose, but gross margin fell a little. 2nm made up 8% of wafer revenue, up from only 3% the quarter before. Fourth-quarter guidance is $52.3B to $54.3B.

## Lithography

$ASML's third-quarter revenue was €11.7B, with a gross margin of 57.5%. Net income was €5.0B. It sold 113 new machines. The CEO said that under the current plan, supply in 2027 and 2028 cannot meet customer demand. Some customers already want to place orders for 2029 and 2030.
What does not add up: the report gives no order amounts. It only says order momentum rose each quarter. For now, we can only take the company's word on how big demand really is.

## Power

$GEV signed 20 GW of gas equipment contracts in the second quarter. Of that, 18 GW were capacity reservation agreements. Only 2 GW were firm orders. Gas turbine backlog plus reservations totals 116 GW. The company said it expects at least 125 GW by year end.
The reservations have not yet become firm orders. The third-quarter report on October 28 will show how much of the 18 GW has converted.

October 28: GE Vernova third-quarter report. Watch whether reservations turn into orders.
October 29: SK hynix third-quarter report. FnGuide's consensus expects operating profit of about 77 trillion won and an operating margin of about 78%. Check whether HBM is as tight as it is at Micron.
Cloud providers also report their third quarters in the coming days. In July, Alphabet raised its capex guidance for this year from a range of $180B to $190B to a range of $195B to $205B. This time, watch whether it raises the range again. In the end, revenue at these upstream companies is the cloud providers' capex.

My conclusion: memory is where the money is most concentrated right now. Power has the thinnest evidence. For memory, watch whether gross margin can stay near 86% next quarter. For power, watch whether reservations can turn into real orders.

en.title: Anthropic model token volume on OpenRouter rose 3.6x after Opus 5.5 launched
en.deck: This number shows that people are using it, but it comes from only one platform. It cannot be taken as direct evidence of Anthropic's total usage or reputation.
en.body:
## What happened

OpenRouter published a set of data. After Opus 5.5 launched, the 7-day average token volume for Anthropic models rose 3.6x. Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 also drew a good response.

A token is roughly a unit that measures how a model processes text. The more tokens used, the more requests are being made to the model.

## Key numbers

- 3.6x: The rise in the 7-day average token volume for Anthropic models after Opus 5.5 launched
- One platform: This data comes only from OpenRouter. It does not represent Anthropic's total usage.

## What it shows

Traffic from one platform shows that people are using it. That is already a useful signal.

## What it does not show

- Anthropic's total usage
- Whether people like it or whether it works well

Someone saying they have not heard any negative feedback is a personal impression, not data. Heavy use does not mean the product is good.

## Why it matters

AI model buzz is often used as proof of success. Telling "people use it" apart from "it works well" keeps readers from treating one platform's traffic as a conclusion about the whole market.

en.deck: I went through the latest quarterly reports of the four laser companies Serenity mentions most, and revenue is surging at all four, but one company's books made me pause.
en.body:
## Lumentum $LITE

For the quarter ended June 27, revenue was $1.01B, up 109.3% year over year and up 24.5% quarter over quarter. GAAP gross margin was 47.4%. Next-quarter guidance is $1.225B to $1.275B. In the press release, the CEO said demand is rising for the ultra-high-power lasers used in CPO (co-packaged optics). Optical links are becoming the main way data centers connect.

## Coherent $COHR

For the quarter ended June 30, revenue was $2.05B, up 34% year over year. Data center and communications revenue was $1.615B, compared with $1.018B a year ago. That is an increase of about 59%, calculated from the two periods. GAAP gross margin was 38.5%. Next-quarter guidance is $2.2B to $2.4B.

## Applied Optoelectronics $AAOI

For the quarter ended June 30, revenue was $191.9M, compared with $103.0M a year ago. 800G product revenue more than doubled quarter over quarter. The company said demand will keep exceeding capacity until mid-2027.

This is the one that stopped me. GAAP gross margin was 27.7%, lower than 30.3% a year ago. The quarter also had a net loss of $22.8M. The money for expansion is coming from share sales. The third ATM (at-the-market) offering this year sold out on October 5. It sold 5,694,845 shares at an average price of $105.36, for net proceeds of $588.0M. Serenity has also criticized this kind of repeated share issuance.

## AXT $AXTI

For the quarter ended June 30, revenue was $47.6M, up 164% from $18.0M a year ago. Indium phosphide revenue was $30.7M, the highest in company history. GAAP gross margin was 44.9%, and net income was $11.1M. On the earnings call, the CFO said that in Q2 the company signed long-term supply agreements with Casella and Coherent. The two customers prepaid $22.3M and $25.4M, respectively.

Customers paying first and waiting for product is the kind of setup I like most.

## My conclusion

Revenue at all four is doubling or close to it, but the ways they make money are very different. $LITE has a 47.4% gross margin. $AXTI is taking customer prepayments. $AAOI has a 27.7% gross margin and is still issuing stock.

Whether lasers can become the next HBM depends, in my view, on whether gross margins can keep climbing the way Micron's did. Right now, $LITE and $AXTI are on that path.

The next quarterly reports from these companies are due around November. I will check the numbers again then.

1. Open sec.gov and search for the company name.
2. Find the Exhibit 99.1 press release in the latest 8-K.

- 有观点认为，现在的下跌已经不是“救不救”的问题了，今天爆仓的可能会更多，也不只是 AI 泡沫那么简单。

- 两融就是融资融券，简单说就是借钱买股票（融资），或者借股票卖出（融券）。
- 只看两融余额，只能知道借出去的钱一共有多少，看不出压力是在变大还是变小。
- 更有用的是融资买入额占成交额的比例，它能看出市场交易里有多少是靠借来的钱撑着。

## 明天盯什么

- 融资净偿还，就是还掉的钱比新借的多。
- 这往往是被动去杠杆的信号，比单看余额更直接。

别只盯总额，要看借钱的人是在加杠杆还是在还钱。明天先看融资净偿还。

en.title: Don't Only Watch the Total Margin Balance. Tomorrow, Watch Net Financing Repayment.
en.deck: The total amount borrowed to trade stocks can be misleading, while repayment activity shows whether anyone is being forced to sell.
en.body:
## What Happened

- Some people believe the sell-off is no longer about whether it can be rescued. More margin calls may happen today, and the cause is not only the AI bubble.
- The conclusion is direct: tomorrow, look at the margin trading data.

## How to Read Margin Data

- In short, margin trading means buying stock with borrowed money (margin financing), or selling borrowed stock (short selling).
- Looking only at the margin balance tells you how much money has been lent in total. It does not show whether pressure is rising or falling.
- A more useful measure is financing purchases as a share of turnover. It shows how much of the trading is supported by borrowed money.

## What to Watch Tomorrow

- Net financing repayment means more money was paid back than newly borrowed.
- This is often a sign of forced deleveraging. It is a more direct signal than the balance alone.

## In Short

影视飓风Tim也来踩𝕏的风口了。这条帖子的说法是，简中𝕏的含金量还在上升，所以不少创作者开始往这里走。

创作者涌进一个平台，通常已经是热度的后段了。头部账号一进场，平台给的分发池往往早就满了，新人很难分到流量。

- 热度来得快，回流来得慢
- 粉丝数涨得快，但钱有没有回到创作者手里，要慢很多才看得出来

大号进场只说明热度在，不说明平台已经值得长期投入。先看钱走到了哪一跳，再下结论。

AI 的订单越签越大，这些订单什么时候变成现金，是这一轮最该对的账。我把三家公司最新一季的原文都翻了一遍，表格在最后。

一、甲骨文
截至 8 月 31 日的季度，收入 $19.3B，同比涨 30%。云基础设施收入 $7.4B，涨 121%。未履约合同（RPO）$664B，一年里多了 $209B，这个季度又签了超过 $30B 的 AI 云合同。
现金这边，经营现金流 $23.1B，资本开支 $28.5B，自由现金流负 $5.4B。往前推四个季度加起来，自由现金流是负 $28.7B（按季报里四个季度的数字加的）。

二、CoreWeave
二季度收入 $2.575B，同比涨 112%。收入积压约 $104B，公司说这还不含三季度初新签的超过 $25B。
同一个季度净亏损 $626M，利息支出 $640M，光利息就比全部亏损还多。现金流量表里买设备花了 $6.4B。

三、英伟达
截至 7 月 26 日的季度，收入 $96.2B，一年前是 $46.7B。按毛利算，毛利率约 75%。
10-Q 里有两处值得对。供应承诺从上个季度的 $119B 涨到 $279B，一个季度多了 $160B。应收账款里，五个直接客户分别占 22%、14%、13%、11% 和 10%，加起来七成。

四、我的结论
订单不缺，缺的是现金回来的速度。甲骨文要看 RPO 每个季度能转成多少收入，CoreWeave 要看收入涨得能不能追上利息。英伟达一个季度把供应承诺加了 $160B，说明它对明年的需求很有把握，需求一旦掉头，这笔承诺也得它自己扛。
这三家下一次季报都在 11 月到 12 月，到时候再对一次。

3. 按 Ctrl+F 搜 remaining performance obligations 和 free cash flow

## 发生了什么
- 10月22日，Oppenheimer 首次覆盖 AeroVironment，评级是 Outperform，也就是看好，目标价 $205。
- "首次覆盖"的意思是这家券商第一次公开研究这家公司并给出评级。
- 这条消息来自 stockanalysis.com 的新闻转述，原始研报没有看到，读的时候要记住这一点。

## 关键数字
- $117.51：这是收盘价。按它算，$205 的目标价大约高出 74%（这个百分比是我们算的）。
- 这是10月里第四家新覆盖的券商。前三家是 Redburn 给 Neutral $165，Barclays 给 Equal Weight $237，Macquarie 给 Outperform $210。
- 这几周 Citizens 把目标价下调到 $170。

## 投资角度
- $AVAV 这个月的目标价从 $165 到 $237 都有，看多和看平的意见同时存在。
- 这说明市场对它没有统一看法。这只是整理公开信息，不是买卖建议。

## 简单说
目标价是券商认为股票未来可能到的价位，不是保证。一家喊到 $205，另一家给 $165，中间差了一大截。看这类新闻，先看是谁给的、哪天给的，再看有没有原始报告。

## 为什么重要
- 券商的评级和目标价会影响很多人怎么看这只股票，所以分歧本身就是新闻。
- 新覆盖加上别家下调，说明这个月对这只股票的讨论很多。

en.deck: In the same month, brokers set $AVAV price targets anywhere from $165 to $237, a gap wide enough to take a closer look.
en.body:
## What happened
- On October 22, Oppenheimer began covering AeroVironment with an Outperform rating, which means a bullish view, and a $205 price target.
- "Initiating coverage" means this brokerage published its first public research on the company and gave it a rating.
- This news comes from a news summary on stockanalysis.com. We did not see the original research report, so keep that in mind when you read this.

## Key numbers
- $117.51: this is the closing price. Based on it, the $205 target is about 74% higher (we calculated this percentage).
- This is the fourth brokerage to newly cover the stock in October. The first three were Redburn with Neutral at $165, Barclays with Equal Weight at $237, and Macquarie with Outperform at $210.
- In recent weeks, Citizens cut its price target to $170.

## Investment angle
- $AVAV's price targets this month range from $165 to $237, and both bullish and neutral views exist at the same time.
- This shows the market does not share one view on the stock. This is a summary of public information, not a buy or sell recommendation.

## In short
A price target is the price a brokerage thinks a stock could reach in the future. It is not a guarantee. One firm says $205, another says $165, and the gap between them is large. When you read news like this, first check who issued the target and on what day, then see whether the original report is available.

## Why it matters
- Brokerage ratings and price targets shape how many people view a stock, so the disagreement is news in itself.
- New coverage plus cuts from other firms show that this stock has drawn a lot of discussion this month.

body:
## 发生了什么

Arena 上冒出一个新模型，测试代号叫 fe-pichu。代号里看不出是哪家做的。有人读了它的回答，觉得语气中里中气的，有点端着、有分量的感觉。

## 能用来干什么

Arena 是盲测。你不知道背后是哪家的模型，只看两个回答哪个更好。这样比较干净，没有品牌光环影响判断，看到的主要是回答本身。

## 简单说

语气像不像，要看你问的是什么。闲聊和写代码，它的风格可能完全不一样。一两轮对话太少，就下结论，太早了。

## 为什么重要

这类匿名测试是提前观察新模型的一个窗口。先凭印象记下来，多问几种问题再验证，比听别人一句话靠谱得多。

en.title: A new model quietly joined Arena. Does its tone match? Don't judge it from one or two rounds.
en.deck: The codename does not show which company made the model, and Arena is a blind test, so judging its style depends on what you ask it.
en.body:
## What happened

A new model showed up on Arena. Its test codename is fe-pichu. The codename does not show which company built it. Someone who read its answers said the tone sounded strong and full. It also seemed a bit stiff and formal, with a sense of weight.

## What it can be used for

Arena is a blind test. You do not know which company's model is behind each answer. You only see which of two answers is better. This makes the test cleaner, because no brand name shapes your judgment. What you see is mainly the answer itself.

## In short

Whether the tone matches depends on what you ask. Chat and coding may bring out very different styles. One or two rounds is too few. Drawing a conclusion now would be too early.

## Why it matters

Anonymous tests like this are a window for seeing new models early. Write down your first impression. Then ask several kinds of questions to check it. That is far more reliable than taking someone else's word for it.

## 发生了什么

一条帖子说 Tibo 明天会有好消息，并列出了 5 种可能：发布 GPT-6.1 Astra，发布 GPT-6.1 Luna，取消 Plus 用户的 5 小时限制，每人 3 张重置卡，和土豆姐官宣。帖子最后还说，如果以上都没有，那 Tibo 明天请闭麦。

## 关键数字

- 5 种可能，其中两种是模型名：GPT-6.1 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Luna
- 5 小时：Plus 用户现在受的使用时长限制
- 3 张：每人可能拿到的重置卡数量

## 怎么做到的

推理就是模型拿到你的问题后真正干活、生成答案的那一步。限制一取消，大家能用的次数变多，推理用量会先涨。

用量涨了，成本不会停在订阅费上。背后要用的是显卡、HBM 和机房的电。HBM 是高带宽内存，可以理解成显卡旁边装模型数据的高速存储，它直接决定模型能跑多快、能同时服务多少人。订阅费和这些硬件成本并不直接对应。

## 简单说

- 5 种猜测，目前都还没有官方证实
- 如果真取消 5 小时限制，用户先感受到的是用量变化，账单却落在别处
- 明天就能看到答案

## 为什么重要

看 AI 产品放开或限制用量，不能只看订阅价格。用量一涨，卡、内存和电才是真正的成本，这也是这类消息值得多看一眼的原因。

deck: 以前做 3D 模型要懂专业软件、还要高端显卡，现在丢一张图进去，普通电脑也有机会跑起来，门槛低了不少。
body:
## 发生了什么

- speridlabs 开源了 Idol，这是一个图生 3D 模型。
- 你给它一张图，它会直接生成一个完整的 3D 物体。
- 官方说可以直接去试用。

## 关键数字

- 600M 参数，是从零开始预训练的。
- 显存占用不到 7.2 GB，消费级显卡就能跑。
- 生成 1M splats 只要 3 秒。

## 怎么做到的

- Idol 用的是 3D DiT 结构。DiT 可以理解成一种基于 Transformer 的生成网络，思路和现在常见的画图模型相近，只不过这里生成的是 3D 内容。
- 它输出的单位叫 splats。你可以把它想成很多带颜色和透明度的小光斑，把它们拼在一起，就成了一个立体物体。

## 能用来干什么

- 想要一个 3D 物体的雏形，不用从头建模，丢一张图就能先拿到初稿。
- 手上有普通显卡的人，也能在自己的机器上试，不必依赖昂贵的云端服务。

## 简单说

以前 3D 建模是专业活，现在变成了丢张图、等几秒的事，而且对电脑的要求不高。

## 为什么重要

- 3D 内容制作长期被建模技能和硬件门槛卡住。
- 模型开源加上显存要求低，意味着更多人能亲手试，也能在它的基础上继续做事情。

en.title: One Image, 3D Object in 3 Seconds: Idol Is Open Source and Runs on 7.2 GB of VRAM
en.deck: Making a 3D model used to take professional software skills and a high-end graphics card. Now you drop in one image, and an ordinary computer may be able to run it. The barrier is much lower.
en.body:
## What happened

- speridlabs open-sourced Idol, an image-to-3D model.
- You give it one image, and it generates a complete 3D object directly.
- The official team says you can try it right away.

## Key numbers

- 600M parameters, pretrained from scratch.
- It uses under 7.2 GB of VRAM, so consumer graphics cards can run it.
- Generating 1M splats takes only 3 seconds.

## How it works

- Idol uses a 3D DiT architecture. DiT can be understood as a Transformer-based generative network. The approach is close to today's common image models, except that here it generates 3D content.
- Its output unit is called splats. Think of them as many small colored, semi-transparent light spots. Put together, they form a solid object.

## What it can be used for

- If you need a rough 3D object, you can skip modeling from scratch. Drop in one image and get a first draft.
- People with an ordinary graphics card can also run it on their own machine, without relying on expensive cloud services.

## In short

Making 3D content used to be specialist work. Now it means dropping in an image and waiting a few seconds, and the computer does not need to be high-end.

## Why it matters

- Making 3D content has long been held back by modeling skills and hardware barriers.
- An open model with low VRAM needs means more people can try it themselves and build on it.

en.title: In my pinned post on October 24, I wrote: the thinnest evidence right now is in power.
en.deck: Two companies reported third-quarter results this week, and after rereading their filings, I need to change my earlier view that power has the thinnest evidence.
en.body:
GE Vernova: reservations start turning into orders

In the second quarter, 18 GW of the gas equipment signed was only capacity reservations. Only 2 GW were firm orders. The third-quarter filing is clear: 13 GW of existing reservations turned into firm orders.

Firm order backlog rose from 53 GW to 64 GW. Reservations fell from 63 GW to 58 GW.

Backlog plus reservations total 122 GW. The year-end target was raised from at least 125 GW to at least 130 GW.

Power division orders were $21.8B, up 178% organically. Division EBITDA margin was 21.4%, versus 13.4% a year earlier.

Total company backlog was $197B. The company expects it to top $200B in the fourth quarter.

Full-year free cash flow guidance went from $11.5B to $12.5B, and was raised to a range of $16B to $17B.

On the grid side, electrification equipment backlog was $42.2B, up 60% over the year. On the same day, the company also announced a $9.0B acquisition of high-voltage grid equipment maker Trench Group.

## Vertiv: orders are growing faster than shipments

It makes power and cooling for data centers. Third-quarter revenue was $4,313M, up 61%, with 55% organic growth.

Organic orders rose more than 100% year over year. Orders more than doubled while shipments rose 55%, and the backlog is still growing.

Adjusted operating margin was 25.2%, 2.9 percentage points higher than a year earlier. Americas revenue rose 75%.

Full-year revenue guidance was raised by $650M, with a midpoint of $14.65B. The fourth-quarter guidance midpoint is $4.413B, with 50% organic growth.

The CEO said: "We are in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout, and it is still accelerating."

## My conclusion

In power, this quarter moved from "customers paying to hold a spot" to "firm orders." The bottleneck is getting paid first, and this time the money really went into the order book.

Two things to watch next. How much of GE Vernova's remaining 58 GW of reservations can turn into orders next quarter. And whether Vertiv's order growth can keep running ahead of its shipments.

Microsoft and Google report tonight, and Amazon reports tomorrow. In the end, orders at these upstream companies come from cloud providers' capital spending, so I will keep cross-checking against that.

To check this yourself, you need just 3 steps:
1. Open the investor websites of GE Vernova and Vertiv, and find the October 28 earnings press releases.
2. For GE Vernova, look at the GW figures in the Power section.
3. For Vertiv, look at organic orders and guidance.

All the numbers come from both companies' October 28 earnings press releases. This is not a stock call. Whether to buy is your decision.

## 发生了什么

10月30日，$AVAV 报 $126.11，前一个交易日收盘是 $134.88，跌了 6.5%。股价下跌的同时，公司的财务数据也有一个值得停下来看的地方：营收掉得很快。

## 关键数字

上一季度（Q4，财年 2026）营收是 $641.62 million，这一季度（Q1，财年 2027）降到 $480.49 million，环比下滑 25.1%。"环比"就是和紧挨着的上一个季度比。

Q4 是过去五个季度里营收最高的一季。所以拿 Q4 当参照，Q1 的落差就更明显。

## 为什么重要

公司给出的收入指引是 $2.175 billion。指引就是公司对未来收入的预告，投资人很看重这个数字。问题在于，这个目标是按 Q4 那样的量来想的，而 Q1 的实际跑量远低于那个水平。

作者的判断是：要让指引站得住，订单必须回到 Q4 的量级。订单可以理解为客户已经下了单、还没交付的生意，它通常比收入更早出现，所以订单是收入的前兆。Q1 的跑量撑不起这个目标。

## 投资角度

$AVAV 的问题很具体：指引要的是订单回升，而眼下的数字还没有证明这一点。与其只盯着股价涨跌，不如关注接下来订单的变化，看它是否真的往 Q4 的水平靠拢。这只是把判断的依据说清楚，不是买卖建议。

## 简单说

这家公司上一季度的营收是近五个季度的高点，这一季度掉到了 $480.49 million。它给出的 $2.175 billion 指引，等于假设收入会回到高点附近，而能不能回去，要看订单。10月30日股价跌 6.5%，帖子里没有说明原因，所以不能直接把这次下跌归到这组数字上。

en.title: $AVAV Revenue Fell 25.1% Quarter on Quarter, and Its $2.175 billion Guidance Depends on Orders Recovering
en.deck: Revenue fell this fast, yet the company still guided to $2.175 billion, and whether that target can be met depends on orders returning to their earlier high.
en.body:
## What happened

On October 30, $AVAV was at $126.11. The prior trading day's close was $134.88, so the stock fell 6.5%. Alongside the share price drop, the company's financial data has one point worth a closer look: revenue fell quickly.

## Key numbers

Last quarter (Q4, fiscal 2026), revenue was $641.62 million. This quarter (Q1, fiscal 2027), it dropped to $480.49 million, down 25.1% quarter on quarter. "Quarter on quarter" means compared with the quarter immediately before.

Q4 was the highest revenue quarter of the past five quarters. So using Q4 as the reference point makes the Q1 drop look even sharper.

## Why it matters

The company's revenue guidance is $2.175 billion. Guidance is the company's forecast of future revenue, and investors watch this number closely. The problem is that the target was built around a volume like Q4's, while Q1's actual volume ran far below that level.

The author's view is that for the guidance to hold up, orders must return to the Q4 level. Orders are business that customers have already placed but not yet delivered. They usually show up before revenue, so orders are an early sign of revenue. Q1's volume cannot support this target.

## Investment angle

The issue with $AVAV is specific. The guidance requires orders to recover, and the current numbers do not yet prove that. Rather than focusing only on share price moves, it is more useful to watch how orders change from here and whether they move toward the Q4 level. This only explains the basis for the judgment. It is not a buy or sell recommendation.

## In short

The company's revenue last quarter was the high point of the past five quarters. This quarter it fell to $480.49 million. Its $2.175 billion guidance amounts to assuming revenue will return near that high, and whether it can depends on orders. The share price fell 6.5% on October 30, but the post does not say why, so that decline cannot be directly tied to these numbers.

## 发生了什么

你可以把它想成一张已经签好的小订单。AeroVironment 拿到了 PANTHER 相控阵天线的集成授标，用在 SkyRange 高超音速遥测平台上。这笔单子记在 2027 财年第二季度，从 2026 年 8 月 2 日开始。信息来自公司 2026 年 9 月 9 日提交的文件附件，附件里是公司 2027 财年一季度的财报幻灯片。

## 关键数字

- 金额：$43 million
- 占 $2.175 billion 指引中值的 2.0%，这个比例是原文作者自己算的
- 一季度营收是下滑的，这笔单子是下半年放量里的一小块

## 能用来干什么

相控阵天线不靠转动机身，而是用电子方式控制波束指向哪里，所以能很快切换方向去盯住目标。遥测平台的工作，是把测试中的飞行器数据实时传回地面。高超音速飞行非常快，想把它的数据看清楚，就需要这样的设备。这次的合同，就是给这套系统的天线做集成。

## 为什么重要

这不是一个大新闻，但它说明了一件事：指引里的增长，要靠下半年一单一单落地。一季度营收下滑，所以这类已经订下的单子，才是把数字从纸面拉到现实的那一步。钱不多，但已经订下了，这比还在谈的单子踏实得多。

## 投资角度

$AVAV 这次拿到的是一个小单，占指引中值的 2.0%，本身不足以改变对整体的判断。真正要盯的，是后面几个季度的订单能不能支撑指引需要的下半年放量，这比单看这一笔更重要。

en.title: AeroVironment Wins $43 million Antenna Order, Only 2.0% of Guidance Midpoint
en.deck: The sum is not large, but it is part of the second-half ramp that is already booked, which is far more solid than deals still under negotiation.
en.body:
## What happened

Think of it as a small order that has already been signed. AeroVironment won the integrated award for the PANTHER phased array antenna, used on the SkyRange hypersonic telemetry platform. The order is booked in fiscal Q2 2027 and starts on August 2, 2026. The information comes from an attachment to a filing the company submitted on September 9, 2026. The attachment is the earnings slides for fiscal Q1 2027.

## Key numbers

- Amount: $43 million
- 2.0% of the $2.175 billion guidance midpoint. The article's author calculated this ratio.
- Revenue fell in the first quarter. This order is a small piece of the second-half ramp.

## What it can be used for

A phased array antenna does not rely on turning the body. It steers the beam electronically, so it can switch direction quickly to track a target. A telemetry platform sends data from a vehicle under test back to the ground in real time. Hypersonic flight is very fast, and seeing its data clearly takes equipment like this. This contract covers the antenna integration for this system.

## Why it matters

This is not big news, but it shows one thing. Growth in the guidance has to come one order at a time in the second half. Revenue fell in the first quarter, so orders that are already booked are the step that moves the numbers from paper to reality. The amount is small, but it is booked, and that is far more solid than deals still being negotiated.

## Investment angle

$AVAV won a small order here. It equals 2.0% of the guidance midpoint, so on its own it does not change the overall view. The real thing to watch is whether orders over the next few quarters can support the second-half ramp the guidance requires. That matters more than this one deal.

## What Happened
Last night, Halloween, some people on the streets of Shanghai and Shenzhen wore costumes such as sexy nurse outfits and bunny girl outfits. Online, some people asked where these people went at night, and the topic quickly took off.

## How to Read It
- A wild costume does not mean out-of-control behavior
- Most people are just roleplaying to have fun on a holiday
- Guessing what happens later from one outfit is already overthinking

No matter who someone is, checking into a hotel must follow laws and regulations. One outfit cannot be used as a label on someone else, and there is no basis to prove anything from it.

The wilder the Halloween costume, the more it shows that people are playing characters. Enjoy the fun, but do not draw conclusions about others.

en.title: Kratos burned $18.9 million in the second quarter. The $9.3 million from selling Valkyrie made the number look smaller.
en.deck: The burn figure was pulled down by income from selling an asset. To see the real pace of cash use, take that money out first.
en.body:
## What happened

Kratos reported its financial results for the second quarter of 2026. The company's free cash flow was an outflow of $18.9 million. Free cash flow is the cash a company earns from its operations, minus what it spends on equipment and buildings. It shows how much cash is left. This time the number was negative, so cash flowed out on net.

## Key numbers

- Operating cash flow was an outflow of $11.0 million. Day-to-day operations used cash on their own.
- Capital expenditure was $17.2 million. That is the money spent on equipment and buildings.
- Selling Valkyrie, which the company owned, brought in $9.3 million. This money helped the books look better.
- Without the money from selling Valkyrie, the actual burn was $28.2 million. This is a figure the source calculated itself.

## In short

Selling Valkyrie cut the burn figure from $28.2 million to $18.9 million. But income from selling an asset does not come from operations. It will not come every quarter. So, to judge the company's cash use, take that money out first.

Full-year guidance is the outlook the company sets for itself. It expects a free cash outflow of $85 to $105 million for the full year. The company has $1.44 billion in cash reserves. It says that money is meant to pay for growth.

## Investment angle

Read the $KTOS books with the money from selling Valkyrie taken out. This is only a different way to read the financial report. It is not a buy or sell recommendation.

## Why it matters

How fast a company burns cash decides how long its cash can last. When you read a financial report, do not look only at the flattering number. Take out one-time income, and you can see the real rate of cash use.

body:
## 发生了什么

Kratos 的收入从2025年Q4到2026年Q2每个季度都在涨。奇怪的是，同一段时间里营业利润却一路往下掉。Q4 还有 $10.1M 的营业利润，到 Q1 降到 $6.6M，到 Q2 直接变成了 $0.8M 的亏损。

## 关键数字

- 2025年Q4：收入 $345.1M，营业利润 $10.1M
- 2026年Q1：收入 $371.0M，营业利润 $6.6M
- 2026年Q2：收入 $458.8M，营业亏损 $0.8M

从Q4到Q2，收入涨了32.9%，营业利润少了 $10.9M。这些财报数字来自 stockanalysis.com 整理的 SEC 文件，涨幅和减少的金额是按这些数字算出来的。

## 怎么理解

收入是公司卖东西拿到的总钱数。营业利润可以简单理解成，从这些钱里扣掉日常运营的成本之后剩下的部分。两者都涨，才是健康的增长。只有收入涨，说明卖得多，不等于赚得多。

理想的情况是收入涨一点，利润跟着涨更多，这叫经营杠杆。Kratos 现在的情况正好反过来：收入在涨，利润却在缩。这组数字本身没有解释原因，想知道为什么，得去看成本是怎么变化的。

## 为什么重要

很多公司都会讲增长故事，收入数字看起来很好看。但利润才是公司能不能长期站稳的关键。收入一直涨、利润一直掉，投资人和读者都该问一句：增长到底赚不赚钱。

## 投资角度

这只是一组财报数字的观察，不是买卖建议。$KTOS 之后的营业利润能不能重新回升，是值得继续盯的地方。

en.title: Revenue rose 32.9%, but operating profit fell $10.9M
en.deck: Sales keep rising, but the money earned keeps falling, which shows growth has not yet turned into profit, and anyone watching $KTOS should pay attention to this.
en.body:
## What happened

Kratos's revenue rose every quarter from Q4 2025 to Q2 2026. Oddly, over the same period, operating profit kept falling. Q4 still had $10.1M in operating profit. By Q1 it had dropped to $6.6M, and by Q2 it had turned into a $0.8M loss.

## Key numbers

- Q4 2025: revenue $345.1M, operating profit $10.1M
- Q1 2026: revenue $371.0M, operating profit $6.6M
- Q2 2026: revenue $458.8M, operating loss $0.8M

From Q4 to Q2, revenue rose 32.9%, and operating profit fell $10.9M. These financial figures come from SEC filings compiled by stockanalysis.com. The percentage increase and the dollar decline were calculated from these figures.

## How to read it

Revenue is the total money a company takes in from selling things. Operating profit can be understood simply as what is left after the costs of day-to-day operations are taken out of that money. When both rise, that is healthy growth. When only revenue rises, the company is selling more, but that does not mean it is earning more.

The ideal case is when revenue rises a little and profit rises even more. This is called operating leverage. Kratos is the opposite right now: revenue is rising while profit is shrinking. These numbers do not explain why. To find out why, you would need to look at how costs changed.

## Why it matters

Many companies tell a growth story, and the revenue figures can look good. But profit is what decides whether a company can stay on its feet over the long run. When revenue keeps rising and profit keeps falling, investors and readers should ask one question: is the growth actually making money?

## Investor angle

This is only an observation of a set of financial figures. It is not a buy or sell recommendation. Whether $KTOS can bring operating profit back up is worth continuing to watch.

## 发生了什么

帖子说，固收债券这边已经触发了流动性危机。作者的意思是，债券开始被大量卖出，想拿到现金的人变多，钱反而难借。作者还说，"村里"（圈里对有能力托底的一方的俗称）其实有意要救，成交量从10点50开始放大，下午一度稳住。

- 10点50：成交量开始放大
- 下午：价格一度稳住，说明还有人接盘

## 怎么做到的

先说个背景。回购就是拿债券当抵押品去借钱，借多少取决于抵押品值多少，还要打一个折扣，这个折扣叫折扣率。

- 折扣率一高，持有债券的人就得卖债去补保证金
- 卖的人一多，价格被压下去，折扣率又往上走
- 抵押品打的折越多，借到的钱越少，更多人又被逼着卖

作者把它比作银行挤兑：存钱的人多，银行没事，大家都来取钱，银行就撑不住了。原话是："全民存钱可以理解，全民取钱呢？那只有一招，银行不开门！"

## 能用来干什么

作者的建议是，这时候盯回购利率比盯价格靠谱。价格可以被托住一阵，但回购利率就是借钱的成本，它涨，说明资金真的在收紧。只要还有人被追保，价格就撑不了多久。

## 简单说

债券被逼着卖的时候，价格短暂稳住，不等于风险已经过去。要看借钱的成本还在不在往上走。

en.title: Volume rose at 10:50, prices held in the afternoon, but the bond market has not passed the test yet.
en.deck: When bonds are sold under pressure, a short pause in prices does not mean the danger is over, so watch the cost of borrowing to see the real picture.
en.body:
## What happened

The post says the fixed income side of the market has triggered a liquidity crisis. The author means bonds are being sold in large amounts. More people want cash, and borrowing money gets harder. The author also says the "village" (market slang for the party able to step in and support prices) actually wants to rescue the market. Trading volume rose from 10:50, and prices held steady for a while in the afternoon.

## Key numbers

- 10:50: trading volume started to rise
- Afternoon: prices held steady for a while, which shows buyers were still stepping in

## How it is done

First, some background. A repo (repurchase agreement) means using bonds as collateral to borrow money. How much you can borrow depends on the value of the collateral, after a discount. This discount is called the discount rate.

- When the discount rate rises, bond holders have to sell bonds to top up their margin.
- More sellers push prices down, which pushes the discount rate up again.
- The bigger the discount on collateral, the less money can be borrowed, and more people are forced to sell.

The author compares this to a bank run. When many people deposit money, the bank is fine. When everyone comes to withdraw, the bank cannot hold up. The original line reads: "Everyone saving money is understandable. Everyone withdrawing? Then there is only one move left: the bank does not open its doors!"

## What it can be used for

The author's advice is that at this point, watching the repo rate is more useful than watching prices. Prices can be held up for a while, but the repo rate is the cost of borrowing. If it rises, funding is really tightening. As long as people are still facing margin calls, prices cannot hold up for long.

## In short

When bonds are being forced to sell, a short pause in prices does not mean the risk is over. Look at whether the cost of borrowing is still rising.

en.deck: Many people think pay-as-you-go is cheap and that topping up is no burden. In fact, the money often disappears quietly during long conversations.
en.body:
## What happened

A user online shared their experience with the API. At first they thought pay-as-you-go was very cheap. But it cost a dozen-odd yuan a day, and topping up did not feel like a burden. Over one month, the total was far more than GPT Plus and Claude Pro. Their conclusion was that DeepSeek is the most cost-effective choice.

## Key numbers

- A dozen-odd yuan a day: the daily cost under pay-as-you-go billing
- One month: small amounts built up, and the final total was far above the two subscription services

## How it adds up

The API charges by token. A token is a unit of billing for how a model reads and writes text. In a chat, every turn counts the whole earlier history again as input and bills it again. So the longer the conversation, the bigger the bill for each turn. Long chats are often the most expensive part.

## What you can do

If you want to save money, don't just focus on switching models.

- When a topic is done, start a new session, so old history stops being billed again and again
- Don't keep asking endless follow-up questions in one long conversation. Split your questions up.

## In short

Saving money on the API depends less on which model you choose. The key is keeping conversations from growing without limit. Each time costs only a little, and small amounts add up to a large total.

en.title: Central bank draws a line: keep stocks, bonds and currency stable, and prevent systemic financial risk
en.deck: This statement comes from a high level and draws wide attention, but it only sets a floor and does not say which way things will go, so ordinary people should not treat it as a buy or sell signal.
en.body:
## What happened

NPC Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji attended, and central bank governor Pan Gongsheng made a statement. The core message has two points. Keep stock, bond and currency markets running smoothly. Hold the line against systemic financial risk.

## Key numbers

This statement gave no specific numbers and no target values. It is a qualitative remark. In plain terms, it says "nothing major should go wrong."

## What you can use it for

- Treat it as background. It shows that management cares a lot about market stability.
- Don't treat it as a signal. It does not say prices will rise or fall, and it does not name any specific policy.
- To judge risk, start with fund flows and cash flow. Where money is moving, and whether companies have cash on hand, usually shows problems earlier than prices do. Prices usually move last.

## In short

Systemic risk can be understood like this: one problem sets off trouble across a large part of the market, like dominoes. This statement draws a line and tells everyone that the line must hold. Where the line sits, and how things go from here, still depends on the moves that follow.

## Why it matters

The weight of this statement can be seen from the rank of the speaker and the attention it has drawn from outside. But it does not change any financial statement. Whether a company earned money and whether it has enough cash still have to be checked in the financial statements and cash flow itself.

一条市场消息说，今天的资金流入金额约800亿元以上，是这一轮的单日最高。它还提到，历史上只有25年4月8日比这次更高，源文把那一天和关税战放在一起。

## 关键数字
- 今日流入：约800亿元以上。这是已经发生的数字，当天就能查到。
- 明天融资：可能减少500亿。这是预测，要等交易所公布融资余额，才能确认对不对。

融资就是投资者向券商借钱买股票，融资余额是这些借款的总量。所以"明天减少500亿"要等余额公布后，拿前后两个数字一比才知道。

## 简单说
一个数字已经发生，可以去核对。另一个是对未来的判断，要等数据出来才能兑现或落空。读这类消息，先分清哪部分是事实，哪部分是预测。

## 发生了什么

得州当选州长吉娜·伊诺霍萨说，别恨数据中心，要恨它们怎么占得州人的便宜。她的意思是，可以在自己定的条件下和马斯克及其公司建立牢固的合作。但在找到保护得州民众安全的办法之前，现在对数据中心的建设必须停下来。

## 关键数字

- 纳斯达克盘前跌1%：这是市场最先的反应。
- 18 GW：GE Vernova手里那笔占位预约的规模。占位预约就是先把名额留住，等真要用时再落实。

## 为什么重要

数据中心就是专门给AI算力用的大楼，非常耗电。如果得州真的停工，提前占好的电力名额就会受到冲击。我们的判断是，盘前跌1%只是开头，那笔18 GW的预约可能最先松动。

## 投资角度

这件事里被点名的上市公司是GE Vernova（$GEV）。它的18 GW占位预约，是得州停工时最先可能受影响的一环。这是风险推演，不是买卖建议。

## 简单说

州长一句话，股市先用1%的跌幅表了态。要是得州真停工，最先动的可能就是GE Vernova那18 GW的预约。，Note on the cashtag: the source texts never give GE Vernova's ticker. I added `$GEV` from general knowledge because the format asks for a cashtag when a listed company is involved. Check it before publishing.

en.title: Texas Calls a Halt to Data Centers, and GE Vernova's 18 GW Reservations May Loosen First
en.deck: A governor-elect's one sentence already had the Nasdaq down 1% in pre-market trading, and it bears on whether AI data centers can be built on schedule.
en.body:
## What happened

Texas governor-elect Gina Hinojosa said people should not hate data centers. They should hate how the centers take advantage of Texans. Her point is that a strong partnership with Musk and his companies can be built on terms she sets. But until a way is found to protect the safety of Texans, construction of data centers must stop now.

## Key numbers

- Nasdaq down 1% in pre-market trading: This was the market's first reaction.
- 18 GW: The size of the placeholder reservations GE Vernova holds. A placeholder reservation holds a spot now, and the spot is confirmed when the power is actually needed.

## Why it matters

Data centers are the buildings that run AI computing. They use a lot of power. If Texas really halts work, the power slots reserved in advance could take a hit. Our view is that the 1% pre-market drop is only the start, and the 18 GW reservations could loosen first.

## Investment angle

The listed company named in this story is GE Vernova ($GEV). Its 18 GW placeholder reservations are the first link that could be hit if Texas halts work. This is a risk scenario, not a buy or sell recommendation.

## In short

A governor-elect's one sentence sent the Nasdaq down 1% before the open. If Texas really halts work, GE Vernova's 18 GW reservations may be the first to move.

## 发生了什么

2014年，香港苏富比春拍的现场，一件存世极其罕见的明代成化斗彩鸡缸杯，被上海收藏大鳄刘益谦以2.81亿港币拍下，约合3630万美元。

春拍是拍卖行每年春季办的拍卖专场。存世的意思是这件东西流传到今天、还留在世上，数量很少。这次成交，就是一件珍贵藏品在拍场上的一次出手。

## 关键数字

- 2.81亿港币：成交价，约合3630万美元
- 一晚，一次举牌：这个价格就出在这一次竞价里
- 2014年：拍卖发生的年份

## 怎么做到的

拍卖的规矩很简单，谁出的价最高，东西就归谁。有人举牌加价，价格就往上跳，直到没人再出价。

所以成交价是当场那几个人你来我往碰出来的，不是按成本或者市面上的普遍行情算出来的。这个数字很准确地记录了那一晚发生的事，但它不一定代表别的东西。

## 简单说

斗彩是一种瓷器工艺，先用青花在瓷胎上勾好线条，烧过一遍，再在线条之间填上彩色的釉料，再烧一次。这种东西本来就稀少，又碰上特殊的一晚，价格才会被推得这么高。

把这个数字当标尺去量整个品类，量出来的结果很容易偏高。

## 为什么重要

看到天价新闻，先想一想它是怎么来的。一只瓷杯的成交价，并不代表别的瓷器也值这个价。拿单次拍卖的结果去判断一整类东西的价值，是很常见的误会。

## 发生了什么

- SemiAnalysis 实地看了远景在乌兰察布自己建的 Galaxy 园区。
- 园区规划 800 兆瓦 IT，首期 120 兆瓦一年建成，造价只有美国五分之一。

## 关键数字

- **45℃**：英伟达说，Vera Rubin 用 45 摄氏度的水就能散热，不需要免冷机。
- **4.3℃**：这里的年均温，天气冷，散热本来就轻松一些。
- **67%**：园区的绿电比例。

## 怎么做到的

中央冷机可以理解成一台大号空调，专门负责把循环水降温。美国多数数据中心的风冷设备仍然要靠它。这个园区的做法是让液冷和风冷共用一套水环，不再单独设中央冷机。水温 45℃ 就够用，不用费力把水降到很低。

天气冷的地方，省下的主要是风冷那一段。

## 简单说

省钱的办法，大头是把空调省掉。天冷、水温够高，就能靠自然条件散热。这些条件别处未必有，但方法本身可以参考。真正难复制的是那 67% 的绿电，电从哪里来，才是这套账里最不好学的部分。

## 为什么重要

AI 机房最费钱的是电和散热。这个项目说明，在乌兰察布建大规模 AI 机房，造价可以只有美国的五分之一。对关心 AI 基础设施的人来说，建在哪里、用什么电，和用什么芯片同样重要。

en.title: Water at 45℃ is enough to go chiller-free, but 67% green power is the hard part to copy
en.deck: This campus costs one-fifth as much to build as a US data center, the key saving is dropping the central chiller, and the hardest part to copy is where the power comes from.
en.body:
## What happened

- SemiAnalysis visited the Galaxy campus that Envision built on its own in Ulanqab.
- The campus plans 800 MW of IT capacity. The first 120 MW phase was completed in one year. Its build cost is one-fifth of a US build.

## Key numbers

- **45℃**: Nvidia says Vera Rubin can cool with 45℃ water. No chiller-free setup is needed.
- **4.3℃**: The annual average temperature here. Cold weather makes cooling easier.
- **67%**: The share of green power at the campus.

## How it works

A central chiller is a large air conditioner. Its job is to cool the circulating water. Most US data centers still depend on it for their air-cooled equipment. This campus lets liquid cooling and air cooling share one water loop. It does not use a separate central chiller. Water at 45℃ is enough, so there is no need to cool it far below that.

In cold places, the main saving is in the air-cooling part.

## In short

The biggest way to save money is to skip the air conditioning. In cold weather, with warm enough water, the site can cool itself using natural conditions. Other places may not have these conditions, but the method can still serve as a reference. The hardest part to copy is the 67% green power. Where the electricity comes from is the hardest part of this math to learn.

## Why it matters

Power and cooling are the most expensive parts of an AI data center. This project shows that a large AI data center in Ulanqab can cost one-fifth as much as one in the US. For people who follow AI infrastructure, where a site is built and what power it uses matter as much as which chips it runs.

## 发生了什么

药明康德被从美国1260H名单里移除了。它是一家有美国客户的药企，这个变化对它的美国业务有直接影响。

## 1260H名单是什么

这份名单由美国国防部根据国防授权法更新，每年一次。上了名单，国防相关的采购和合作都会受到限制。

- 上榜：国防相关的采购和合作受限
- 移除：说明这个标签在收缩

## 对药企意味着什么

对做美国客户生意的药企来说，标签往往意味着额外的合规审查，也就是多一道检查，证明自己守规矩。移除之后，这部分成本会降下来。

## 不变的是什么

## 简单说

可以把这个标签想成门口的一块牌子。牌子摘掉，进门要查的东西少了，但生意到底好不好，要看财报上的数字。

en.title: WuXi AppTec Comes Off the US 1260H List, and the Label Is Shrinking
en.deck: Being on the list meant one more review for drugmakers doing business in the US. Removal lowers that cost, but whether orders changed is a question for the annual report.
en.body:
## What happened

WuXi AppTec has been removed from the US 1260H list. It is a drugmaker with US customers, so the change has a direct effect on its US business.

## What is the 1260H list

The US Department of Defense updates this list once a year under the National Defense Authorization Act. Companies on the list face limits on defense-related purchasing and cooperation.

- Added: defense-related purchasing and cooperation are restricted
- Removed: the label is shrinking

## What it means for drugmakers

For drugmakers that do business with US customers, the label often means extra compliance reviews. That is one more check to prove they follow the rules. After removal, that cost comes down.

## What has not changed

The list itself does not change the company's revenue structure. Whether orders have really changed will show in the share of revenue from US customers in the next annual report.

## In short

Think of the label as a sign at the door. Take the sign down, and there is less to check at the entrance. But whether the business is doing well depends on the numbers in the financial report.

en.title: A Single Bearing Can Be Worth More Than Half a Rickshaw
en.deck: Parts are not all priced the same, and once precision gets high enough, one small part can decide whether an entire production line can run.
en.body:
## What happened
Someone on social media said a bearing is now worth nearly as much as a rickshaw. That sounds exaggerated. The logic behind it is real. A rickshaw is priced as a whole vehicle. A bearing is priced by precision.

## How it works
A bearing is the part that lets a wheel and an axle turn smoothly. Whether it is good depends on whether its size can be made extremely precise.
- A rickshaw is sold by the vehicle. You are buying one whole machine.
- A bearing is sold by precision. You are buying how exact it can be.

The higher the precision, the harder the part is to make. The cost goes up too.

## Why it matters
When precision is pushed to the extreme, one small part can hold up an entire production line. This spending is the hardest to cut, and the easiest to overlook. The part is small and out of sight. You only learn how important it is when something goes wrong.

## In short
When you judge what something is worth, do not look only at how big it is. The smallest and least noticed part is often the one that decides whether the whole thing can run.

body:
## 发生了什么
集美在Ds社区看到一个现象：很多插件和脚本APP是女孩子写的，她笑到绷不住。这件事本身很轻松，但它引出一个更实用的问题：这些插件靠不靠谱，该怎么判断。

## 先看什么
- 插件和脚本能做什么，主要取决于它被允许读哪些文件。
- 作者的名字、性别或名气，都不会改变电脑执行它时的行为。
- 所以先看它要的权限，比先看作者更有用。

## 能用来干什么
装新插件或脚本之前，先问自己两件事：
- 它要读取哪些文件？
- 这些文件和它声称的功能对得上吗？

如果一个小工具的功能只是排版文字，却要读你整个文档目录，就该多想一想。

## 简单说
电脑不在乎写的人是谁，它在乎的是读文件的权限。

## 为什么重要
大家习惯看作者、看人设，但真正决定风险大小的是权限。把注意力从"谁写的"转到"它能碰什么"，判断会更稳。

en.title: Check what a plugin wants access to before you guess who wrote it
en.deck: Some people joke that most plugins and scripts in the Ds community are written by girls, but for a computer, the author does not matter. What matters is which files it can read.
en.body:
## What happened
Jimei saw a post in the Ds community. Many of the plugins and scripts there were written by girls, and she could not stop laughing. The joke itself is light. But it leads to a more useful question: how do you tell whether these plugins can be trusted?

## What to check first
- What a plugin or script can do depends mainly on which files it is allowed to read.
- The author's name, gender, or reputation does not change how the computer runs it.
- So checking the permissions it asks for is more useful than checking the author.

## How to use this
Before you install a new plugin or script, ask yourself two questions:
- Which files does it need to read?
- Do those files match what it says it does?

If a small tool only formats text but asks to read your whole document folder, it is worth a closer look.

## In short
The computer does not care who wrote the code. It cares about which files the code can read.

## Why it matters
Most people look at the author and the persona. But permissions decide how much risk there is. Shifting focus from "who wrote it" to "what can it touch" leads to steadier decisions.

## 发生了什么

在硅谷，乔布斯那辆银色奔驰SL55 AMG是出了名的怪车。它前后常年不挂车牌，在马路上大摇大摆开了好几年，警察却始终拿它没有办法。

很多人以为这是亿万富豪才有的特权。其实不是，乔布斯钻的是加州法律里的一个小空子。

## 关键数字

- 6个月：新车上路后，最多有这么长的宽限期
- 宽限期内，不挂正式车牌是完全合法的
- 好几年：这辆车常年不挂牌，警察一直没法管

## 怎么做到的

宽限期其实是一段缓冲时间，让刚买的新车可以先开上路，不用马上办完所有手续。

这个空子的重点是那6个月的时钟，车是什么档次倒在其次。

- 宽限期有起止日期
- 车在期内没挂正式牌照才合法
- 过了期限还没上牌，就得上牌

能决定合不合法的，是登记档案里的日期。路上警察看到的车不算数。

## 简单说

这不是钱的特权，是时间的缝隙。宽限期有起止，合法与否看的是登记日期，不是路上的样子。

## 为什么重要

同一辆没挂牌的车，在宽限期内和过期后，法律身份完全不同。遇到类似的说法，可以先问几个问题：宽限期从哪天开始，到哪天结束，登记档案上记的是什么。规则里的日期，往往比肉眼看到的东西更有分量。

en.title: New cars get a 6-month grace period, and Jobs' silver Mercedes relied on that time.
en.deck: This looks like a privilege, but it is really a timing gap built into the rules, and under the law, dates often matter more than the car itself.
en.body:
## What happened

In Silicon Valley, Jobs' silver Mercedes SL55 AMG was a famously strange car. For years, it had no license plate, front or back. It drove openly on the road for several years, and police never managed to stop it.

Many people think this is a privilege only billionaires have. It is not. Jobs used a small loophole in California law.

## Key numbers

- 6 months: the longest grace period a new car can have after it goes on the road
- Within the grace period, driving without a formal license plate is fully legal
- Several years: the car went without a plate for years, and police could not do anything about it

## How it worked

A grace period is really a buffer. It lets a newly bought car go on the road first, without finishing all the paperwork right away.

The key to this loophole is the 6-month clock. What kind of car it is matters less.

- The grace period has a start date and an end date.
- The car is legal only if it has no formal plate during that period.
- If the deadline passes without a plate, the car has to get one.

What decides legality is the date in the registration record. What police see on the road does not count.

## In short

This is not a privilege of money. It is a gap in time. The grace period has a start and an end. Legality depends on the registration date, not on how the car looks on the road.

## Why it matters

The same car with no plate has a completely different legal status inside the grace period and after it expires. When you hear a similar claim, start by asking a few questions. When did the grace period start? When does it end? What does the registration record say? Dates in the rules often carry more weight than what you can see with your own eyes.
